theorem: The 36 spreads carry a rank-three association scheme. Two distinct spreads meet in four lines on the valency-15 relation and in one line on the valency-20 relation. The four-line graph is SRG(36,15,6,6), so every pair of distinct spreads has exactly six two-step four-line intermediates. Its centered adjacency is an exact involution after scaling.
